messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduling a config deploy (non-code) to prod during the 02:00 PST change window. Payload = routing policy tweaks + timeout bumps + batching parameter adjustments.

deploy-bot: Patch preview:
```
routingPolicy:
  prefer: low-cost
  pinModel: model-icetower-v2
timeouts:
  request: 12s -> 15s
  streaming: 60s -> 75s
batching:
  max_batch_size: 256 -> 180
  max_batch_latency_ms: 20 -> 30
rateLimit:
  per_token_ms: unchanged
```

casey: Quick q — why lower max_batch_size?

anil: We reduce batch size to cut tail latency under high concurrency. Also prevents OOM on older instance classes.

tanya: Are we pinning traffic to model-icetower-v2 by default? That spiked cost in last perf run.

maria: Only for routes with strict reliability SLOs. We add an opt-out flag for cost-sensitive routes.

sam: Rollback triggers/plan?

deploy-bot: Canary plan: 5% for 15m -> 20% for 30m -> ramp to 100% if no alerts. Automated rollback triggers: error rate +2% absolute, p95 latency +200ms, or memory OOM. Manual override allowed.

anil: Add /admin/pin-route for immediate manual pin if we need to keep prior routing for specific customers.

tanya: Need headers/tracing updates so we can correlate routing decisions to traces.

maria: Will emit route=pin metadata and span tags. Pushing an observability dashboard: eng-runtime/routing/param-tweaks.

casey: +1 to dashboard. Also suggest a nightly cooldown block 23:30-01:00 to avoid overlap with other infra ops.

deploy-bot: Change window set to 02:00-03:00 PST per ops calendar. Noted on cooldown.

ops-bot: FYI infra stretch scheduled 03:30 PST — confirmed OK to proceed.

sam: I'll watch the canary and post updates. If anything looks off I'll trigger rollback.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 1963456793 -> 5% traffic.

sam: Canary metrics @5m: error rate steady, p95 +60ms, memory normal.

anil: At ~13m one shard shows p95 drift +250ms. I'm pinning that shard back to the previous selector and holding ramp.

tanya: Acknowledged. Initiating shard pin for affected customer groups.

sam: Holding ramp. Ops on-call investigating kernel-level stalls on the shard host.

deploy-bot: Canary halted at 5% due to manual intervention; automated ramp paused.

maria: Decision: pause the rollout. Revert routing pin for shard-a to pre-change selector, keep other changes staged. We'll open a follow-up to re-evaluate batching latency vs cost tradeoffs.

casey: Filing a short release-note entry: "routing + batching parameter adjustments — canary paused due to p95 tail on shard-a; manual pin applied; follow-up evaluation planned."

sam: Ack. I'll monitor and close thread after postmortem invites are scheduled.

deploy-bot: Canary stopped; changes not promoted. Thread closed at 1963457000
